title: Sharp enrichment and its tensor and cotensor adjunctions
statement: Use marked simplicial sets, the markings $K^\flat,K^\sharp$, products and the internal Hom $H(X,Y)=Y^X$ of [lem-coef-marked-internal-hom]. For marked simplicial sets $X,Y$ put $$\operatorname{Map}^\sharp(X,Y)_n=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{sSet}^+}(X\times(\Delta^n)^\sharp,Y),$$ with operators by restriction. These mapping simplicial sets give a simplicial enrichment of the category of marked simplicial sets: vertices are its morphisms, identities are their constant parameter families, and the composite of $f:X\times(\Delta^n)^\sharp\to Y$ and $g:Y\times(\Delta^n)^\sharp\to Z$ is $(x,t)\mapsto g(f(x,t),t)$. Composition is associative and unital. For every simplicial set $K$, the tensor and cotensor exist and are respectively $X\otimes K=X\times K^\sharp$ and $Y^K=H(K^\sharp,Y)$. More precisely, there are natural isomorphisms of simplicial sets $$\operatorname{Map}^\sharp(X\times K^\sharp,Y)\cong\operatorname{Fun}(K,\operatorname{Map}^\sharp(X,Y))\cong\operatorname{Map}^\sharp(X,H(K^\sharp,Y)).$$ Here $\operatorname{Fun}(K,T)_n=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{sSet}}(K\times\Delta^n,T)$ for any simplicial set $T$. Both isomorphisms are the currying bijections, using the same marked map on $X\times K^\sharp\times(\Delta^n)^\sharp$ and interchanging its last two factors. They respect restriction, composition and identities. All constructions are relative to the input universe.
